title: 잠깐만 means Wait a sec — sing along 🎵 #learnkorean
caption:
Hear it, clap it, say it: 잠깐만 (jam-kkan-man) = “wait a sec”.
This is casual Korean. To be polite, add 요: 잠깐만요 (jam-kkan-man-yo).
Say it on the beat when it’s your turn, and you’ve got it!

_원문.title: 잠깐만는 잠깐만라는 뜻 — 따라 불러 🎵
_원문.caption:
듣고, 손뼉 치고, 말해: 잠깐만(jam-kkan-man) = 「잠깐만」.
반말이다. 공손하게 하려면 요를 붙여: 잠깐만요(jam-kkan-man-yo).
빈 박에 말하면 다 배운 거야!
